package.name: hexa_display
package.description: Hexapod "face" node. Maps robot state (gait, cmd_vel, posture, battery) into an expression/gaze/blink policy and rasterizes the eyes on a 256x64 SH1122 OLED directly from a Raspberry Pi (spidev + the kernel GPIO character device), in one process. A pure sink of robot state: nothing imports it. The platform-free eye animation core (EyeAnim/EyeRaster, shared with the ESP32 / Pico firmware) and the u8g2 C driver are vendored under vendor/ (see vendor/README.md), so the package builds without a firmware checkout. No external GPIO library.
